CLOUDS MAY HAVE OBSCURED PORTIONS OF THE ANOMALY. THE RELATIVE PROXIMITY TO LAND ALLOWED FOR THE POSSIBILITY THAT THIS WAS A FALSE POSITIVE. THUS, CONFIDENCE THAT THIS WAS OIL IS MEDIUM-HIGH.

Report Description*****NOAA/NESDIS MPSR ISSUED FOR: ATLANTIC***** POSSIBLE, UNCONFIRMED OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. REPORT DATE: 08-30-2026 REPORT TIME: 1154 UTC REGION: ATLANTIC SUB REGION: MID ATLANTIC U.S. AREA/BLOCK: NORTH ATLANTIC 7004 IMAGE DATE: 08-29-2026 IMAGE TIME: 2225 UTC DATA SOURCE: RADARSAT2 MODE: SCANSAR NARROW VV RESOLUTION: 50 METER LOCATION: 40°06'02" N/69°55'03" W AREA: 0.98 SQUARE KILOMETERS CONFIDENCE: HIGH REPORT MAP/GIS FILES: HTTPS://WWW.OSPO.NOAA.GOV/PRODUCTS/OCEAN/MARINEPOLLUTION/ REMARKS: POSSIBLE OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THIS ANOMALY IS UNCONFIRMED AS OIL. THE ANOMALY APPEARED TO BE EMANATING FROM THE KNOWN REPEAT LEAK SOURCE, WRECK 1487, LOCATED 90 NM SOUTH OF NANTUCKET, MASSACHUSETTS. IT EXHIBITED OBSERVABLE CONTRAST AGAINST THE OCEAN BACKGROUND IN SAR IMAGERY AND HAD AN UNNATURAL SHAPE. Report DescriptionTHIS IS AN UPDATE TO NRC REPORT 1415047/// THE UPDATED INFO IS AS FOLLOWS: CALLER REPORTED THAT THE CAUSE OF THE RELEASE WAS DETERMINED THAT THERE WAS A PLUG IN THE CITY OF NEWARK"S SEWER LINE. THE SRP HAS BEEN UPDATED. THE CAUSE OF THE PLUG IS UNKNOWN TO THE CALLER. THE MATERIAL RELEASED IS INDUSTRIAL WASTE WATER AND IT WENT OUT ONTO THE GROUND AND INTO A STORM DRAIN THAT LEADS TO THE PASSAIC RIVER. THE CAUSE OF THE PLUGGED LINE IS UNKNOWN AT THIS TIME.
